title: Kula Today
heading: Today · Fri 30 Oct
summary: A flat day (forecast light). Thermals stayed flat all day. The upslope ran from about 08:30 to about 16:15. A low day for October: the base stayed down near 3,300 ft (normal 4,500–5,400 ft). The evening before, the page called it normal, about 4,000 ft, a miss. Midday the base averaged about 3,300 ft by the Kekoa camera, 700 ft lower than the evening's number; the morning update said about 4,000 ft, off by 700 ft. Most of the day the shear line was crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio; furthest north about 10:40, at Pukalani. Data gaps: no readings all day from 1 station (Nakula); Kamehamenui 1 stopped at 15:48; Kula 1 stopped at 15:48; the Mesonet could not be reached on 14 of 60 updates.
